date: 5th Day of the Harvest Moon, Year 682 After Baronies Founding
title: The secret horror of the Druidic Circle
author: Boon J. Cobson

content:
As we all know the druidic circles are a popular place for the youth of the town to go to, where they play tricks and do their nightly parties. Who among us has not gone there when young with stolen wine or even more? He who is innocent cast the first stone. But what is the druidic circle really? What is the secret horror that lies within it? From our sources we have learned that the druidic circle was built on top of an old multi-roomed shrine dedicated to an ancient long forgotten horrid god.

Follow along dear reader as we go through the events as they unfolded.

As we all know, with the loss of the Darkspire and the upcoming winter we would need to sell our remaining supplies of Fathomwyrm oil and other Fathomwyrm produce. However what was discovered by the Baron and the town council was that the Fathomwyrm oil was contaminated with a strange substance that made it smell like rotten eggs.

Together with our failed cropses and our sooner than expected expired grains this would spell disaster for our town. These events though peeked the interest of our Darkspire heroes. They decided to investigate the source of the contamination and the larger than expected vermin that were plagueing our town, it did not take them long to notice that they were connected. They traced the source of the contamination to the druidic circle, and they found out that the druidic circle was built on top of an old shrine.

The adventurers discovered a hidden entrance underneath the druidic circle that led to a series of tunnels and chambers. As they explored deeper, they encountered strange symbols and even more horrific recently sacrificed human remains. They soon realized that the druidic circle was not just a place for parties and tricks, but a place of dark rituals and sacrifices. But to what goal? Who was behind this? What was the purpose of the shrine? These are questions that we might have never known the answer to if not for our young locals.

After an attack by plagued rats our adventurers returned to the surface and called for assistance from Captain Alric and the mage Tolvjen as well as the town guards Stein and Victoria. Together they went further into the shrine. From interviewing them it seems that the shrine was a connected series of rooms all dedicated to transforming the blood and remains of a humanoid sacrifice. This all fed some kind of magical portal found in the shrine. The portal was a gateway to another plane of existence, a plane of darkness and horror.

The adventurers fought their way through the shrine, facing off against the one that was behind the misfortune of our town. Reader, let me tell you, I do not know if we should even say the name of the one behind this, but it was one of our own. None other than our local priest Father Delm. Yes you read that right, the one who is supposed to be the spiritual guide of our town was the reason behind our misfortune. He was the one who was performing the dark rituals and sacrifices in the shrine, and he was the one who was behind the contamination of our Fathomwyrm oil.

The adventurers fought Father Delm and defeated him but the portal itself had one last trick up its sleeve. It transformed Father Delm into a monstrous creature. The adventurers fought this creature and eventually defeated it, but in the fight we learnt that they got contaminated with some kind of dark disease that is slowly eating away at Den Jef and Alfred. 

The adventurers were able to close the portal and stop the contamination, but the damage was already done. The town was saved, but at a great cost, the expired goods are lost, the harvest is a failure but to give a sliver of hope to our readers, at least most of the oil was saved. To end this story we the Darkspire Insider have learnt that Den Jef and Alfred are recovering from their disease but their aid might be needed soon enough again as according to the rumours tracks were found in the shrine of some kind of horrid beast out there, lurking in the dark.
